product_one_liner.value: Obsidian Security provides enterprise security teams with visibility, threat detection, and access controls to protect SaaS applications, identities, and AI agents.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes unified visibility across identities and SaaS applications, real-time threat detection, least-privilege enforcement, and protection for non-human identities and AI agents. Sources: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/obsidiansecurity/jobs/4864479008 and https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/news/unlocking-ai-potential-securely.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page describes free entry and modular adoption: https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company explicitly names Snowflake, T-Mobile, and Wyndham Hotels and Resorts as enterprises that trust Obsidian: https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/careers. | named_customers.0: Snowflake is named among enterprises trusting Obsidian at https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/careers. | named_customers.1: T-Mobile is named among enterprises trusting Obsidian at https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/careers. | named_customers.2: Wyndham Hotels and Resorts is named among enterprises trusting Obsidian at https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/careers.

employee_band.notes: Revelio Labs reports 249 employees worldwide as of March 2026, which falls within 201-500. This is a dated third-party estimate: https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/obsidian-security/employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company's announcement explicitly says it is headquartered in Palo Alto, California: https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/news/unlocking-ai-potential-securely. | hq_country: The company identifies its headquarters as Palo Alto, California, and its job posting identifies that location as USA: https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/news/unlocking-ai-potential-securely and https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/obsidiansecurity/jobs/5290880008.

founded_year.notes: The company careers page explicitly states that Obsidian Security was founded in 2017: https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/careers.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed blog index is product/security-marketing oriented. Only one reviewed post, the engineer-coauthored Impossible Travel article, met the product-building criterion; the required two qualifying posts were not established. Sources: https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/blog and https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/blog/modern-threat-detection-impossible-travel.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation/help link was found in the reviewed homepage navigation. The documentation URL directs users to access documentation from their authenticated Obsidian portal rather than exposing public articles. Sources: https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/ and https://docs.obsidiansecurity.com/obsidian/api/graphql.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live AI Security Engineer - Taiwan posting satisfies the requested title criterion: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/obsidiansecurity/jobs/5406173008.

model_provider.notes: No underlying model/provider was established after checking the gated documentation, AI Assistant page and FAQ, implementation-related blog posts, and subprocessor disclosures. Named supported AI platforms were not treated as models powering Obsidian itself. Sources: https://docs.obsidiansecurity.com/obsidian/api/graphql, https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/obsidian-ai-assistant, https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/blog/accelerate-your-security-operations-with-ai-assistant, and https://trust.obsidiansecurity.com/.

raised_18mo.notes: The $85 million financing announced August 4, 2026 falls within the preceding 18 months: https://www.obsidiansecurity.com/news/unlocking-ai-potential-securely.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A live Enterprise Account Executive - Central posting directly meets the requested role criterion: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/obsidiansecurity/jobs/4993906008.

launched_6mo.notes: On May 14, 2026, Obsidian announced expanded coverage to more than 200 enterprise applications, a substantive connector-coverage expansion within the six-month window: http://www.obsidiansecurity.com/blog/obsidian-expands-connector-coverage.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Terah Chan's profile records joining Obsidian as VP, FP&A in August 2026 after Zip. A separate dated item reports Asanga Wanigatunga joining as VP of Asia Pacific and Japan in July 2026. Both fall within the 12-month window; internal promotions were excluded. Sources: https://linkedin.com/in/terahchan and https://www.theofficialboard.com/news/obsidian-security.
